name: rooms-sft-real-v1
_what: One release of the room-annotation pipeline: which pipeline code, which fine-tuned adapter, and how that adapter must be asked. deploy/release.py reads this; nothing here is duplicated in code.
_code_fingerprint: sha256 over src/**/*.py, 12 hex. The band below was measured on THIS code; the 2026-10-28 merge fix moved every baseline ~.025, so a band from other code says nothing about this one.

adapter._path: Relative to this file's parent's parent (the repo root), so a checkout elsewhere still resolves. Override with --adapter-root.
adapter._digests: The pipeline raises only when the adapter directory is MISSING. A present-but-wrong adapter loads happily and reports success, so the weights are pinned by content, not by path.
adapter._nested_copy_warning: trained_adapters/sft_real_v1/ contains a byte-identical nested copy at sft_real_v1/sft_real_v1/ and in checkpoint-948/. Point at the parent. All three share md5 46bf22fee037dcb157c4797cf8772b80.

invocation._flags: What the production chains actually pass, not what config defaults to -- those differ (use_sam3_exemplar defaults False but every real run enables it). --unsloth-adapter is appended by release.py from the resolved adapter path.
invocation._extent: --use-vector-room-extent adds coordinates.extent beside each room's label box, from the source PDF's own wall layers. It is a SECOND output: the label box stays the room's location (substituting the extent box moves 11 rooms' centres out of their GT room, located 915 -> 904), and the extent step writes no other field, so label recall is unaffected. Only CAD-layer PDFs carry extents at all -- see known_limits.room_extent.
invocation._prompt: sft_label is NOT optional. The adapter was trained on it; asked with the default 'production' prompt it degrades silently -- no error, just worse output. This pairing is the single most important thing this manifest enforces.
invocation._seed: Seeded sampling here is deterministic end-to-end: a fresh 3h28m GPU re-run on 2026-11-12 reproduced the entire scored report bit-identically. Pinning the seed makes a release reproducible, not merely repeatable.

expectations._band_pin: The recall band is NOT copied here. It lives in one file, read by the CPU regression test, the GPU pin chain and this release. A band in two places is a band that will disagree with itself.
expectations._config_must_match: Checked post-run against the run's own pipeline_config.json. Preflight proves intent; this proves what actually ran. A flag silently dropped by a future CLI change is caught here and nowhere else.
expectations._log_must_not_contain: Phrases a clean run never writes to its pipeline_*.log. Both detectors (yolo_detector.py, sam3_exemplar_detector.py) catch every load failure, log this and return no detections, so the run still 'succeeds'. Preflight proves the detectors can load; this proves they did. test_release.py fails if the phrase leaves the detectors, which would turn this check into a vacuous pass.
expectations._summary_must_report: Keys an optional step this release switches on writes into post_processing_summary.json. A step that never ran leaves no key -- and leaves a run that otherwise looks complete, because nothing downstream requires the field. Checked post-run, like the log.
expectations._summary_must_be_zero: Tallies that mean the step ran but could not see its input. The extent step needs the run's source PDF, found from the page-image stem; a deployment that stages PDFs elsewhere produces zero extents and still exits 0. NOT listed here: pages_unreadable and a zero rooms_with_extent, which are properties of the input (a scanned or FLAT PDF carries no wall layers) rather than of the deployment.

known_limits.label_recall: ~0.611 on the 13-document GT set; the band file holds the exact interval.
known_limits.room_extent: PARTIAL, and a second output only. Measured on this release's own code with eval/room_extent_eval.py over adapter_real_v1_b1275_pincheck: 311 of 1072 rooms on 28 of 48 pages get an extent; 286 of 1497 GT rooms are matched at IoU >= .5 -- extent recall .191 at precision .920, against 0 for label boxes. Coverage is bounded by the input, not by tuning: extents come from a CAD PDF's own wall layers, so scanned and FLAT exports carry none (5 of 10 scored documents get zero). The label box remains each room's location.
known_limits.export_surface: Extents reach the COCO export as per-annotation attributes (extent_bbox, extent_segmentation, extent_source), never as the annotation's own bbox or segmentation. The Label Studio export carries none: its regions are bound to the controls in a labeling config this repo does not hold, so a polygon there needs a project change first. The Qwen SFT exporter reads label boxes only -- training on extents would be a different task.
known_limits._why_here: A deployable unit that does not state what it cannot do gets deployed against the wrong expectation.
